ravi_s: quick follow-up from today's authz fire-drill — root cause looks like a stale token-validation cache + missing audit flags on a subset of service accounts. want owners + short timelines for remediation items: token validation fix, permissions test harness, audit logging retention fix, secrets rotation dry-run. propose quick-phased deadlines (3/7/5/10 business days). who can pick which?

emma_ops: I can own the token validation fix. will open a PR and include a smoke test. ETA 3 business days. assigning to myself now. :thumbsup:

liam_prod: i'll take the permissions test harness. will add an integration job + a small regression suite against the authz matrix. target 7 business days. tagging @emma_ops for test hooks. :eyes:

sophia_sec: i'll handle audit logging retention and the secrets rotation dry-run. need infra support for KMS rotation policy and log retention ACLs. planning a dry-run first in staging. ETA 5 & 10 days respectively.

infra_team: noted — can provide KMS rotation window and a staging key. will need ticket and list of affected service accounts. recommend scheduling rotation during maintenance window.

ravi_s: created infra ticket INC-4321 and added initial list of SA principals. link: https://internal.redwood/infra/INC-4321. also created a short remediation checklist: ```- PR: r/validate-token-cache-fix
- Test: integration + regressions (authz matrix)
- Rollout: canary -> 25% -> global
- Audit: ensure audit.events include token_validation=true for svc accounts
- Secrets: dry-run rotation in staging, then prod window
```

emma_ops: quick note on the code path — cache TTL is in `authn/cache.go` (var TokenCacheTTL). changing TTL to 5s is safe for now until we root-cause upstream invalidation. will send PR with migration notes.

liam_prod: for harness, i'll add a nightly matrix run and a pre-deploy gate. snippet for gating job: ```jobs:
  authz_matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./bin/authz-test --matrix ./configs/authz-matrix.yaml
```

sophia_sec: for audit retention, want to set retention=90d on the authz index and add an alert if events drop below expected throughput. i'll draft the alert query and retention PR.

remediation-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: #7201 token-validation-fix (owner=emma_ops, due=1812604878), #7202 permissions-harness (owner=liam_prod, due=1813191678), #7203 audit-retention (owner=sophia_sec, due=1812772478), #7204 secrets-rotation-dryrun (owner=sophia_sec, due=1813459678). See /remediations for details.

ravi_s: thanks all. can each owner drop a short checklist item in #remediations when they create PRs/alerts so we can track. i'll do a quick canary plan review with SRE after PRs land. :white_check_mark:

emma_ops: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/2345 (WIP). added unit + smoke tests. marking owner in remediation ticket.

liam_prod: harness job created in CI, will kick off first matrix run tonight and report results tomorrow.

sophia_sec: audit PR drafted, secrets dry-run plan in doc w/ step-by-step and rollback. pinging infra for KMS key schedule. :lock:

ravi_s: great. next check-in in 48h or sooner if blockers. thanks everyone. :pray:
